summary: Family dispute over property ownership; power of attorney misused for sale; trial court granted injunction restraining sale; High Court set aside injunction; SC restored injunction based on prima facie case of property being joint family asset; balance of convenience favors plaintiffs; power of attorney limited to administrative functions not sale; consideration below market value; failure to establish clean title by defendants; irreparable loss to plaintiffs if sale finalized.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order 39 Rules 1 and 2
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; trial court's injunction restored; defendants restrained from dealing with property pending suit.
